blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon on Sunday said those defending the Duterte political family appeared to be aligned with China, pointing to a possible overlap between pro-Duterte online networks and narratives supporting Beijing. “The defenders of the Dutertes are the same ones defending China, aren’t they?” Ridon said in a post on X, formerly Twitter, written in Filipino. His remarks came amid a sharp exchange between Philippine lawmakers and the Chinese Embassy, which followed Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan’s statement that China “may easily win” a conflict but chooses not to because “we love peace.” The Department of Foreign […]...
